station_event_note: 2 * JR boardings assumes balanced exits. Not unique people. Hanzomon/Fukutoshin are not added again because of shared Tokyu station counts. Remaining transfers still overlap.
curve_method: Analyst approximation constrained by Shibuya Industry and Tourism Vision, printed pp.19-20, 2018 domestic resident presence: rise from 07:00, plateau 14:00-16:00, faster fall after 19:00. Weights are not measured hourly crossing counts or a digitisation. Presence-to-trip conversion is a placeholder. Normalised to station-event proxy times assumed 12% street capture.
peak_source: User-requested upper-demand scenario, not a current measured official crossing count. Applied as a separate multiplier to the normalised curve.
signal_note: Illustrative phase plan; no actual traffic controller timings used. Clearance extends until active pedestrians finish in the browser; traffic is held while they remain.
train_note: Headways, offsets, wave size and exit split are assumptions; not an official timetable. Waves reassign existing agents, never add uncounted visual people.
behavior_note: All routing, origin/destination shares, capture, background population, exposure, intent and visit probabilities are placeholders. Each simulated agent has weight 1; no fluid field. Default 20,000 is a performance/demo population, not observed simultaneous occupancy.
license_note: Only factual numeric entries and our own assumptions are bundled from operator statistics. Original websites/documents are linked, not redistributed. PLATEAU geometry and OSM geometry have separate licenses; see NOTICE. City report contains third-party mobile statistics: no raw mobile data or report graphics redistributed.
